items.title: Back the brain up to a private GitHub repo
items.what: The brain is already a git repo. Add one private GitHub remote and push at every /wrap.
items.does: Closes the open gap on the board: the brain has had no off-machine copy since it left iCloud. If the Mac dies, you lose nothing, and every past version stays readable.
items.costSource: GitHub Free plan: unlimited private repos (github.com/pricing, Scout, 2026-09-24)

items.title: Show each post's results in the Planner
items.what: After a post runs, read its reach, saves and comments back into the Planner and Posts cards.
items.does: Closes the loop on content: Sage sees which slots and formats earn attention, and the next content week is planned from results, not guesses.
items.costSource: Uses the Meta connector read-only. First step is checking it can read organic post results; if it cannot, Metricool (paid, below) can.

items.title: Monthly customer-language file from reviews.io
items.what: Scout pulls the month's reviews and keeps the exact phrases buyers use (speed, crowd size, how it compares to their old pot) in one swipe file.
items.does: Maya and Sage write ads and captions in customers' own words. Real phrases usually beat ones we invent.

items.title: Set a 30 QT CAC ceiling
items.what: Beau works out the break-even cost per customer for the 30 QT fryers, the same way as the other products.
items.does: Two live ads (Video_Jay 30qt and Heavy Duty Heat.30qt) can't be read against a kill line today. This lets the kill table cover them.
items.costSource: Beau, from margin data already on file

items.title: Connect Canva to Claude
items.what: Authorize the Canva connector that is already installed but not signed in.
items.does: ROUX can resize a design for each placement, check it against the brand kit, and pull your Canva work into Posts without downloads.
items.costSource: Canva $18/mo already on the budget; the connector adds nothing

items.title: Metricool for scheduling FB and IG
items.what: A scheduling tool with a Claude connector. Posts get scheduled by API instead of by driving Business Suite in Chrome.
items.does: The Schedule button runs faster and stops breaking when Meta changes the composer. It can also report each post's results.
items.costSource: metricool.com/pricing (Scout, 2026-09-24). Not confirmed: whether the Claude connector needs the Advanced plan ($67/mo, or $53/mo yearly). Check before paying. Already on your list for Mon 9/28.

items.title: Backblaze backup for the whole Mac
items.what: Continuous offsite backup of the Mac, including the photo and video library, which is too big for a GitHub repo.
items.does: Protects the lifestyle photos, the shoot footage and the renders, not just the brain's text files.

items.title: Obsidian Sync for the brain on your phone
items.what: Syncs the vault to your phone and laptop, with version history.
items.does: Read the board, the plan and any report from your phone at a trade show or in the shop. It is not a backup.
items.cost: $5/mo, or $4/mo yearly (Standard, 1 GB). Plus: $10/mo, or $8/mo yearly (10 GB)

items.title: Ahrefs Starter for competitor and keyword checks
items.what: Read-only keyword and competitor lookups for Scout. SEO work stays Coalition's lane.
items.does: Lets us check Coalition's SEO reports against a second source, and see what search terms competitors win on.

items.title: Claude Max 20x, only if you hit limits
items.what: Moves the plan from Max 5x to Max 20x: four times the usage.
items.does: Room for long runs (content week, full ad reviews, scheduling) on the same day without hitting a usage cap. Skip it if you never hit one.

items.title: Triple Whale attribution (Beau to weigh first)
items.what: An attribution dashboard that joins Shopify orders to ad clicks across Meta and Google.
items.does: One view of which ads bring new buyers. We already get most of this from Shopify-tagged orders, so Beau should say if the gap is worth it.
items.cost: Not confirmed. The Shopify App Store shows $219/mo (Foundation); the price scales with store sales
items.costSource: apps.shopify.com/triplewhale-1 (Scout, 2026-09-24). Triple Whale's own page blocked the check.
